text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross! Back-to-back victories 
for Tamamo Cross!! Following the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), she now conquers the Japan Cup 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The clash of "Lightning" vs. "Monster" 
goes to the Lightning once again! 
Thunderous applause erupts from the 
venue—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was magnificent……. Just as the 
President said, this race will go down in 
history.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like... something fateful is 
happening here... Wait, never mind that, 
Tamamo-san, Oguri-san! Waaaaaahhhhhhh!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, whew...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ogurii... what d'ya think?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama... You've grown even further... Even 
now, to be so...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's incredible... Does she really have 
no weaknesses at all...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Course I did. Who d'ya think I am?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm the Lightning of Naniwa, Tamamo Cross! 
Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it ain't settled yet. Next time. 
Next time will be the real showdown.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. Make sure you bring 
yourself to your absolute limit! Don't you 
dare disappoint me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course. I'll show you I can win 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Tama. It's so much fun, it 
really is. And if I win, even more so...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer. Hahaha... See? Told ya 
so, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I polish it thoroughly, I can make it. 
...As long as I don't worry about the 
consequences.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is fine, just like this. There's only 
one left, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's all good. We won, so cheer up and 
show some joy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, "she has no weaknesses anywhere," 
huh? Her eyes must be blind as a bat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's totally obvious, ya know. She's way 
scarier— clashing with sparks flying no 
matter the distance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is totally the best. Racing is so 
much fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running like this forever. 
With Oguri... forever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' if I can keep winnin', that'd be the 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I know full well that's impossible. And 
that is precisely what makes it so 
thrilling, so ecstatic.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm really grateful. That this body 
of mine held up again today...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more, just a little bit 
more...! Let me sprint all the way through 
to the end!
